thread:
jessica: FYI customer acme-prod opened a ticket — function/tool-calling in JSON mode failing with 400. They pasted payload. From support email: `400: invalid JSON: expected array for 'order_ids' but got string`.

alex: Can you paste the exact request body they used?

jessica: Here's the payload from their logs:
```json
{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","tool":"get_orders","arguments":{"order_id":"12345"}}
```

chris: ok schema for get_orders expects `order_ids` (array of strings). That mismatch would cause parse failure in JSON mode.

maria: Are they using our SDK or direct REST? Any SDK version?

jessica: They say SDK v0.8.2 via node. Also reported a flurry of retries causing unexpected charge increases — looks like client retries on 400 which increased token usage.

dev-bot: Ticket #INC-4521 created and linked to thread.

alex: Reproduction steps: I tried same body with curl and got 400 with message `expected array but got string` from runtime. Sample curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","tool":"get_orders","arguments":{"order_id":"12345"}}'
```

alex: Also reproduced with SDK v0.8.2 — SDK didn't validate and forwarded body; runtime rejected. SDK should fail earlier.

chris: Proposed mitigation: (1) quick runtime change to accept single string and coerce into single-element array (backcompat), (2) add server-side more explicit 400 error message with suggestion, (3) patch SDK to validate argument shapes for declared function signatures.

maria: For billing: we need to mark customer with credit for retry-related overcharge. Support, please create billing inquiry and flag as urgent.

jessica: Filed billing case BTC-332. Support assigned to maria.

oncall-ml: @alex @chris can you prioritize a canary rollout for coercion fix? Low risk, should reduce customer pain. Also add a unit test for `order_ids`/`order_id` acceptance.

alex: I'll open PR with tests; aiming for canary tonight.

sre-rod: Watch for spikes. If coercion causes unexpected accepts, we may hide real schema errors. Recommend producing a deprecation warning in logs when coercion occurs.

chris: Good call. We'll log a warning to customer telemetry and include a header `X-Redwood-Compat-Warn: coerced-order_ids`.

jessica: Customer updated — they've turned off client retries and will wait for canary. Thanks team.

maria: Closing loop — billing credit requested, support notified.

dev-bot: PR #4825 opened by alex -> eng-runtime. Linked to INC-4521.

oncall-ml: Assigning to eng-runtime (alex) and eng-ml (chris) for follow-up. I'll monitor.

jessica: marking thread P2 for now; escalate to P1 if more customers hit this.

alex: Will update when canary is live.
